projects.title: Medication Log API
projects.description: REST API for a personal medication log, built in vertical slices that each ship to production before the next one starts.
highlights: Token authentication with django-rest-knox: tokens stored hashed, fixed expiry, deleted on logout.
Closed by default: endpoints without an explicit permission refuse anonymous requests, and login never reveals which accounts exist.
Care with personal data: responses return only what each endpoint needs, and the public environment holds only fictional data.
Documented with OpenAPI and a public Swagger UI page.
Multi-stage, non-root Docker image served by Granian, deployed on Render with Neon PostgreSQL after CI passes (lint, strict mypy, tests against PostgreSQL, image build).

projects.title: SkillBridge - Freelancer Platform Backend
projects.description: First modules of a freelancing-platform backend.
highlights: Accounts and profiles with a custom user model (email login), abstract base models, one-to-one and many-to-many relations, custom validators and admin panel.
Check and unique constraints enforced in the database.
304 automated tests and a four-job GitHub Actions CI: tests against PostgreSQL with a 95% coverage gate, Ruff and strict mypy, Docker image build and full-history secret scanning (Gitleaks).
Passwords hashed with Argon2id, and Dependabot keeps dependencies up to date.
Log messages never include emails or passwords.

projects.title: School Manager API - Django REST Framework
projects.description: REST API with Django REST Framework: CRUD endpoints for students, courses and enrollments, enrollment listings per student and per course, and reusable custom validators (CPF, name, phone) applied at model and serializer level.
projects.shortDescription: REST API with Django REST Framework: CRUD for students, courses and enrollments, with custom validators (CPF, name, phone).

projects.title: Alura Space - Django Architecture & Refactor
projects.description: Space-photo gallery built following three Alura Django courses, one per branch (templates, data persistence and admin, forms and authentication). After the courses, I refactored the project on my own initiative: a hierarchical template inheritance structure and reusable partials cut about 70% of duplicated HTML, added search by name and category, and adopted Conventional Commits.
projects.shortDescription: Django photo gallery built from three Alura courses. My refactor with template inheritance cut about 70% of duplicated HTML and added search.

projects.title: SecureBank API - JWT Authentication
projects.description: Flask REST API for user registration, login and balance updates, built following a Rocketseat course. Authentication uses JWT, with a middleware that checks the token's user against the request. I replaced the course's bcrypt with Argon2 for password hashing. Includes unit tests with pytest.
projects.shortDescription: Flask REST API with JWT authentication. I replaced the course's bcrypt with Argon2 and added pytest unit tests.

projects.title: Clean Code Flask API
projects.description: REST API with Flask organized in layers: controllers, repositories, views and validators. Uses interfaces and dependency injection, custom HTTP exceptions, input validation, and unit tests for controllers and the repository. Built following a course on clean code, MVC and SOLID.
projects.shortDescription: Layered Flask API (controllers, repositories, validators) with dependency injection and unit tests.

projects.title: NLW Operator - Computer Vision
projects.description: Advanced computer vision monorepo featuring a LeNet-5 CNN implementation for MNIST, a custom gesture recognition lab with MediaPipe and YOLO, and a real-time web application built with FastHTML and WebSockets for low-latency video processing.

text: Through my legal career and a postgraduate degree in Civil Law (PUC Minas), I developed critical document analysis, clear communication and empathetic listening, skills I apply to understand real needs before building any solution.
After moving to Portugal, I worked for years in a restaurant, where I strengthened my adaptability and teamwork in a fast-paced routine, always ready to support the team and deliver quality service.

Today, I build personal backend projects in Python: REST APIs with Django and Django REST Framework, token authentication and OpenAPI documentation, PostgreSQL, automated tests, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Docker and cloud deployment.
